name: Light Steps
source:
Alone in a frozen wasteland, Lalami has no memory of her past. She encounters Josiah, equally lost, Timon, who insists he knows her, and Agnes, a shadowy figure trailing them.

As they journey together, hidden truths surface. Who will she believe?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31596]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
